svg.title: Equipotentials of two equal positive charges
svg.desc: Computed equipotentials of two equal positive charges. Close to each charge they are small circles. The equipotential through the midpoint, drawn heavier, is a figure eight whose two lobes enclose the two charges and cross at the midpoint, where the field is zero (a saddle point of the potential). Lower potentials give single closed curves around both charges, pinched at the waist at first and becoming nearly circular farther out. The perpendicular bisector is not an equipotential: the potential is highest at the midpoint along it. Faint field lines run outward from both charges, crossing every equipotential at right angles. The potential increases toward either charge.
